scenes.title: THE COLD AWAKENING
scenes.description: Your consciousness returns as a freezing sensation. You are floating in viscous gel. An amber emergency light flickers. You are trapped in a stasis pod. The gel is draining, revealing dim, archaic control panels.

options.raw: Try to wipe the condensation. (Go to SCENE 2)

options.text: Panic and thrash in the pod
options.raw: Panic and thrash in the pod. (Go to SCENE 2)
Wait for the drainage sequence. (Go to SCENE 2)

scenes.title: EXHUMATION
scenes.description: The pod hiss-pops open. The transition from zero-G gel to heavy artificial gravity is brutal. You collapse onto cold metal grating. The air smells sterile and ancient. You cough up residual fluid, your limbs weak as wet noodles. You are alone in a room.

options.text: Check the console next to your pod
options.raw: Check the console next to your pod. (Go to SCENE 3)

options.text: Ignore the console and seek a way out
options.raw: Ignore the console and seek a way out. (Go to SCENE 4)

scenes.title: AMBER MESSAGES
scenes.description: The green CRT monitor is cracked but functional. You boot the system. LOG START YEAR 2037: STATION: AETHELRED-HULL 4. CLASS: LEADER. STATUS: EMERGENCY AWAKENING CYCLE. The interface demands confirmation of the last global protocol. You search your hazy memory.

options.raw: Enter Protocol 'GULF SHIFT'. (GO TO SCENE 2)
Enter Protocol 'WHITE OSLO'. (Go to SCENE 5)
Enter Protocol 'ATOM FALL'. (GO TO SCENE 2)

scenes.title: SUBMERGED CORRIDOR
scenes.description: You stumble into a corridor. The structure groans under immense pressure. Through a thick viewport, you see only deep blue darkness. Small, bio- luminescent creatures drift by. You aren't just in a base; you are deep underwater. A bulkhead blocks the path.

options.raw: Locate the manual bypass wheel. (Go to SCENE 6)
Look for another route. (Go to SCENE 5)

scenes.title: CONFIRMED IDENTITY
scenes.description: IDENTITY CONFIRMED: SUBJECT K-81. A screen with fingerprint reader next to the exit. An audio log plays: "The Middle East thermal bloom... the Gulf Stream collapsed. We are activating AETHELRED. Welcome to the new Ice Age, K-81. Report to Core."

options.raw: Take the service elevator up. (Go to SCENE 7)
Try to open a bulkhead. (Go to SCENE 6)

scenes.title: MECHANICAL FAILURE
scenes.description: You seize the bypass wheel. It's seized with rust. You strain, your weak muscles screaming. With a sharp crack, it gives. You hear a scary sound from the other side.

options.raw: Push through the doorway quickly. (Go to SCENE 7)
Go back to the terminal. (Go to SCENE 5)

scenes.title: THE ASCENT
scenes.description: You enter the elevator shaft. The lift is broken. You must climb the emergency ladder. It feels like miles. Your hands blister. The groan of the metal deepens as you ascend toward the distant hum of massive machinery.

options.raw: Keep climbing toward the hum. (Go to SCENE 8)

options.text: Stop to rest on maintenance platform
options.raw: Stop to rest on maintenance platform. (Go to SCENE 8)

scenes.title: DRY LAND
scenes.description: You reach a hatch and pull yourself through. This level is dry. The lighting is stable, cast in functional white LED. The air is slightly less stale. You are in a large maintenance bay.

options.raw: Search for clothes or equipment. (Go to SCENE 9)
Advance down the main corridor. (Go to SCENE 10)

scenes.title: UNIFORM
scenes.description: You find a locker. Inside is a grey jumpsuit. The patch reads: AETHELRED CORE - LEADER CLASS. A small medical kit heals your blisters. You also find a digital multi-tool.

options.raw: Continue to the main corridor. (Go to SCENE 10)

scenes.title: FIRST CONTACT
scenes.description: You step into the corridor. A figure in a blue jumpsuit approaches. It's a woman, her face tense. She holds a plasma welder defensively. "Identify yourself!"

options.text: "I am K-81, Leader Class. Just awakened."
options.raw: "I am K-81, Leader Class. Just awakened." (Go to SCENE 11)
"Who are you?" (Go to SCENE 11)

scenes.title: ELARA
scenes.description: She lowers the welder slightly. "I am Elara, Worker Class. Maintenance, Sector 7." Her expression is cautious. "You are early. The rotation schedule said next month. But I need your help."

options.raw: "The pod system is malfunctioning." (Go to SCENE 12)
"How can I help?" (Go to SCENE 12)

scenes.title: THE TRUTH OF AETHELRED
scenes.description: Elara leads you to an observation deck. She punches a command. The blast shutters open. You are on an enormous oil platform. The ocean below is pure ice. Elara looks out. "The government? They died in Oslo. But Project AETHELRED survived."

options.text: Ask about the state of the world
options.raw: Ask about the state of the world. (Go to SCENE 13)
Ask what happened to Norway? (Go to SCENE 13)

scenes.title: THE HISTORY LESSON
scenes.description: It was after the Iranian war. The burning oil refinery and the dirty nuclear bombs. It all collapsed in 2028. But these ocean platforms was secretly rebuilt for a new ice age. Now we are all that is left."

options.raw: "What is the Worker class?" (Go to SCENE 14)

scenes.title: THE ROTATION SCHEME
scenes.description: A shadow crosses her face. "Workers like me... we don't have stasis pods. We maintain the reactor. We grow the food. We live and die in the Core. But now the Core is dying. To keep everyone alive, we need to fix the Core."

options.text: Attempt to apologize for the system
options.raw: Attempt to apologize for the system. (Go to SCENE 15)
Ask about the dying Core. (Go to SCENE 15)

scenes.title: MEMORY CHECK I
scenes.description: "But only a few have access, and the leader on this shift is in a coma after the virus started to spread. I need your fingerprint and the access code. It is the year the AETHELRED project was secretly initiated in the old calendar, but only leaders know."

options.raw: Code: 1999. (WRONG ANSWER. TRY AGAIN FROM SCENE 14)
Code: 2021. (WRONG ANSWER. TRY AGAIN FROM SCENE 14)
Code: 2028. (Go to SCENE 16)

scenes.title: THE AI CORE
scenes.description: The code works. Inside, massive, outdated mainframes fill a cavernous room. Elara begins working quickly at a terminal. "The weather is worse, and still too cold outside. The core needs a new algorithm."

options.text: Offer to help with the core's diagnostics
options.raw: Offer to help with the core's diagnostics. (Go to SCENE 17)

options.text: She knows what to do. Watch her work from a distance
options.raw: She knows what to do. Watch her work from a distance. (Go to SCENE 18)

scenes.title: TECHNICAL BOND
scenes.description: You use your multi-tool to bypass a faulty relay. Now the screen boots, and you can fix the algorithm. Elara looks up, surprised by your competence. A genuine smile breaks across her face. "Not all Leaders are useless politicians," she quips.

options.raw: Continue working together. (Go to SCENE 19)

scenes.title: CHILLY OBSERVATION
scenes.description: You stand back. Elara works with efficient, practiced movements. But the core does not stabilize. She looks at you, her expression again guarded. You are just another Leader.

options.raw: Help Elara (GO to SCENE 17)

scenes.title: ASSIGNMENT
scenes.description: You log in to the terminal. K-81: EMERGENCY - AWAKE EARLY TO OPTIMIZE FUSION STABILIZER ALGORITHM, SECTOR 7. DURATION: 1 YEAR. PREP FOR STASIS RETURN: YEAR 2143.

options.raw: Accept assignment. (Go to SCENE 20)

scenes.title: SHARED SECTOR
scenes.description: The Fusion Terminal is located in Sector 7—the same sector Elara maintains. Over the next few weeks, you work in close proximity. You are tierd, but the mutual isolation draws you together.

options.raw: Engage Elara in conversation. (Go to SCENE 21)
Keep your relationship professional. (Go to SCENE 21)

scenes.title: THE OBSERVATION DECK
scenes.description: During your scarce downtime, you meet her on the Observation Deck. She talks about how she used to dream of the blue sky. You share your own memories of the world before the ice and grey clouds. You remember your private stuff in storage.

options.text: Share your secret stash of coffee
options.raw: Share your secret stash of coffee. (Go to SCENE 22)

options.text: Ask her if she resents you
options.raw: Ask her if she resents you. (Go to SCENE 23)

scenes.title: COFFEE AND COMPLICITY
scenes.description: The aroma of real coffee fills the sterile deck. Her eyes widen. "This... this is contraband, K-81." She laughs, a rare, beautiful sound. You drink the aromatic brew together.

options.raw: Hold her hand. (Go to SCENE 24)
Tell her she's beautiful. (Go to SCENE 24)

scenes.title: RESENTMENT
scenes.description: "Do I Resent you? We all do our job. You sleep to preserve the intellect for the future. I work to keep us alive now. It is what it is." The honesty is real.

options.text: Apologize and share the secret coffee
options.raw: Apologize and share the secret coffee (Go to SCENE 24)

scenes.title: THE KISS
scenes.description: The proximity. You look at her, and realize she is the only other human that matters in this world of ice. It feels forbidden, the air is electric.

options.raw: Embrace Elara (Go to SCENE 25)
Kiss Elara (Go to SCENE 25)

scenes.title: THE HIDDEN SEASON
scenes.description: You meet hidden in maintenance tunnels and the shadows of the fusion core. Your tuned algorithm makes the corn run again at peak efficiency. But the AI wants to put you back in stasis.

options.raw: The weeks pass... (Go to SCENE 26)

scenes.title: MEMORY CHECK II
scenes.description: "STASIS PROTOCOL UNSTABLE" AI controlled robots force you to the terminal. The pods will die without a reset command based on your stasis rotation pattern.

options.raw: 5 Years Awake / 1 Year Asleep. (GO TO SCENE 25)
1 Year Awake / 5 Years Asleep. (Go to SCENE 27)
1 Year Awake / 10 Years Asleep. (GO TO SCENE 25)

scenes.title: T-MINUS ONE MONTH
scenes.description: The code is correct. The other pods stabilizes. A notification flashes: FORCED STASIS INITIATING IN T-MINUS 720 HOURS. PREPARE FOR DEEP FREEZE.

options.raw: Seek out Elara immediately. (Go to SCENE 28)
Run and kiss Elara. (Go to SCENE 29)

scenes.title: IMPOSSIBLE CHOICES
scenes.description: You find Elara in the hidden tunnel. "When you wake up, I will be older, K-81. And you... you will still be you. My whole life will happen while you sleep." "It does not matter."

options.text: "I will sabotage my pod. I will stay"
options.raw: "I will sabotage my pod. I will stay" (Go to SCENE 29)

options.text: "Wait for me in my next shift."
options.raw: "Wait for me in my next shift." (Go to SCENE 30)

scenes.title: SABOTAGE (A CHANCE?)
scenes.description: "If you stay," Elara whispers, "we will have to hide from the AI supervision, or else you will be forced into stasis. And another leader will be woken."

options.text: Attempt to hide from the AI
options.raw: Attempt to hide from the AI. (Go to SCENE 26)

options.text: Acceptance. Make the most of ur days
options.raw: Acceptance. Make the most of ur days. (Go to SCENE 30)

scenes.title: THE DEEP FREEZE
scenes.description: The final hour. You are standing outside your stasis pod. Elara stands beside you. "I’ll be here when you wake up," she promises. The visor closes. The thick green gel begins to fill the chamber. Her face is blurred by the rising fluid. "I love you!"
